model.note: Model switched mid-run by operator direction. All subagents ran on Opus per the project override at every point; no Sonnet, Haiku, MiniMax, Luna or Sol lane was used.

denominator_note: The ~100 target is a target, not a quota. P09's domain-appropriate population of bindable storage/state products and projects is smaller than 100 once marketing-only and non-embeddable entries are excluded. Two named surfaces (Crunchy Data, Elastic Cloud Serverless) could not be verified and are recorded as rejected/unverified rather than counted as evidence.

smoke.method: Structural validation over every packet file: JSONL parsed line by line, required fields (id, evidence_class, observed) asserted, duplicate and mis-prefixed IDs checked, top10 counts re-derived from disposition fields, decision-ledger JSON parsed.
